## Rose Quartz — Crystal Empire spa stylist (G4)

Rose Quartz is the fan-identified pink Crystal Pony mare among the spa attendants in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Look for her rosy-pink coat, very pale blue-gray mane and tail, pale gray-blue eyes, and the sparkling, faceted Crystal Pony look. She is an Earth pony, not a unicorn or pegasus. She is easiest to recognize in the Crystal Empire spa scene, rather than through a personal storyline.

[![Rose Quartz in *Games Ponies Play* — production still from *Friendship Is Magic*](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/mlp/images/c/c6/Crystal_pink_mare_shrugs_S3E12.png/revision/latest?cb=20130210032425)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/File:Crystal_pink_mare_shrugs_S3E12.png)

*Image attribution:* Screen capture from Hasbro Studios/DHX Media's *Friendship Is Magic*, S3E12; the linked file page gives the image context.

### Name, voice, and appearances

- *Name:* “Rose Quartz” is a community/wiki identification for this background pony; I could not verify an official Hasbro name, on-screen introduction, or named merchandise credit. The gemstone name fits her Crystal Empire setting, but its original coiner is unverified. She is not the yellow Ponyville florist Rose/Roseluck.
- *Speaking:* No individually attributed dialogue or verified voice actor. Her cutie mark is not securely documented.
- *Appearances:* *Games Ponies Play* (S3E12), *The Crystalling – Part 1* (S6E1), and the season-three character poster, according to the [Crystal Pony character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Crystal_Ponies) and [spa-pony overview](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Spa_ponies).
- *Continuity:* She is a background character in the official G4 television series. A different [fan-fiction Rose Quartz](https://my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic-rakoon1.fandom.com/wiki/Rose_Quartz) is portrayed as a crystal pegasus princess; that fan-created history does not belong to this show's spa attendant.

## Important moments

Rose Quartz has no verified character-centered speech or consequential decisions, so these are identifiable scenes, not an invented personal arc.

1. *Crystal spa introduction* — *Games Ponies Play* (S3E12): She appears among the Crystal Empire's stylists as Cadance prepares for the Equestria Games inspector's visit, establishing her on-screen occupation. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=93GCcQ9wl7A); exact scene timestamp unavailable.
2. *Return to the Crystal Empire* — *The Crystalling – Part 1* (S6E1): She appears again, showing that this spa pony design recurs beyond season three. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jhGRiw2kYkc); exact scene timestamp unavailable.
